editorial.description_en: A leaf with frost still on it: green only just enough to be called green, and the lightest entry in the group.
editorial.description_ja: 霜のおりた葉のような、うすい緑。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.900, C 0.020, h 140.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 霜 (shimo, frost) + 葉 (ha, leaf), rendaku to -ba. It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Frosted Leaf" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 霜葉. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — usu-shiba at ΔE00 5.0, iwa-shimizu at ΔE00 5.1, tani-giri at ΔE00 5.4. complementary is empty because at chroma 0.020 the hue is not a reliable enough statement to oppose. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
